name: preview-pr-bot
description: Shared GitHub Action: on every CWI app repo PR, builds the branch, posts a Pages preview link + schema-validation checklist as a PR comment. Previews deploy to pr-previews/<PR#>/ — production untouched, $0.
intended_use: CWI engineering / any multi-repo Pages org.
limitations: Template lives in workspace; promotion to a public cwi-ci-templates repo is queued to Black (standing no-publish rule).
conversion_note: 3 test PRs: bot comment + 200 previews + loud fail gate (2026-10-01).
